description: Pass the one-off ids the visitor picked; returns each item's price, the list total, the combo discount by item count (job board listings never count), and the final total. For the speaker programme pass speaker_rungs to price a subset of the ladder (Stage always included); omit it for the full programme at the bundle price. This is the only arithmetic that counts — never add prices yourself. The AI-channel percentage does not apply to one-offs. Next: book_intro_call to lock the date, or get_partnership_options if the basket is starting to look like a year.

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

oneoff_ids.description: Required. One-off ids from get_reach_options One or more of: meetup-hosted, speaker-development, conference-main-stage, newsletter-dedicated, newsletter-classified, dinner, podcast-episode, survey, job-listing.

speaker_rungs.description: Speaker programme rung ids (stage, story, coach, amplify, beyond) to price instead of the full programme; stage is always included

name: quote_reach_combo
title: Price a one-off basket (authoritative total with the combo discount)
